title: U.S. GDP Growth Slowed in Second Quarter of 2026
partialText: Gross domestic product grew at a slower rate in the second quarter and persistent price pressures are unsettling financial markets.

title: Markets Challenge Warsh’s Approach to Taming Inflation
partialText: Kevin M. Warsh has made controlling inflation the top priority of his tenure as Federal Reserve chairman. But his hesitancy to embrace the possibility of higher borrowing costs has sparked a backlash.

title: Why Todd Blanche’s Attorney General Confirmation Is Stalled
partialText: The decision by the acting attorney general, Todd Blanche, to grant President Trump protection from I.R.S. audits has become the central issue in his confirmation process.

title: Attack on Egyptian Port Shows Suez Canal’s Vulnerability
partialText: The port where the Wednesday strike occurred is near the Suez Canal, through which a significant amount of the world’s shipping moves.

title: U.S. Sees Iran as Likely Behind Cyberattack on Minnesota Water Systems
partialText: Investigators cautioned that the assessment was preliminary. There were no indications that any water supply had been rendered unsafe to drink.

title: Russia Strikes Ukraine With Missiles and Drones, Killing at Least 8
partialText: President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine said five members of a family had been killed in the latest large-scale aerial assault by Moscow.

title: NATO Says Russian Missile Hit Poland During Ukraine Attack
partialText: Russian missiles have briefly entered Polish airspace in the past. Investigators have yet to definitively identify the object that struck overnight.

title: Who Put Candy on a Diet?
partialText: “Healthy” confections, whether marketed as “better-for-you” or “functional,” have overwhelmed grocery and convenience stores, and even found their way into gyms and supplement shops.

title: A Bay Area Pastor Made an A.I. Twin to Talk About God at Any Time
partialText: To meet the growing needs of his church, Justin Lester created an A.I. duplicate of himself. Every day he sees more people using it.

title: DOJ Seeks to Use Court to Deport Mother of Convicted ISIS Supporter
partialText: The case is an early test of a court that has never been used before, where much of the evidence is presented in secret and defendants cannot challenge how it was collected.

title: Rescue Boat Crews Show Signs of Brain Injuries, but Coast Guard Isn’t Looking
partialText: Untreated and undiagnosed, the crews that save lives in the roughest seas face the relentless pounding of waves.

title: European Wildfires Amplified by Emptying Countryside and Fewer Farms
partialText: A warming planet and a shift away from farming have set the stage for larger fires on the continent. “We must learn to coexist with them,” one report said.

title: Wildfires in Greece Kill 3 Firefighters as Blazes Still Burn in France and Spain
partialText: Greece also worked to contain blazes on Lesbos and in the Peloponnese, where another firefighter died, in the midst of a brutal wildfire season for Europe.

title: When A.I. Invaded ‘Heated Rivalry’ Fan Fiction, the Meltdown Was Epic
partialText: An anonymous X account posted a detailed breakdown of chatbot text in 38 popular stories inspired by the hockey romance. The fandom spiraled.

title: Apple’s Siri Got an A.I. Brain Transplant. Try These 5 Prompts to Get Acclimated.
partialText: An upgrade transformed the beleaguered virtual assistant into a modern chatbot. It’s imperfect but worth trying.

title: L.A. Warehouse Fire Leaves Behind Rats, Flies and an Unending Stench
partialText: The Boyle Heights neighborhood of Los Angeles is still dealing with the smell of rotting food and fears over possible toxins after a cold-storage facility burst into flames in June.

title: What We Really Learned From the Fauci Hearing
partialText: Show trials are bad for democracy.

title: How Older Americans Hoard the Future
partialText: Aging politicians are just the “tip of the iceberg.”

title: Retribution
partialText: We look at the ongoing fight between the Trump administration and James Comey.

title: Were You Stuck Footing the Bill on a Group Trip? Tell Us About It.
partialText: Traveling with friends can be tricky. We’re curious how you manage financial friction — and how you make sure your besties settle up.

title: For Museum Boss Who Became a Trump Target, It’s Déjà Vu All Over Again
partialText: Kim Sajet left as director of the National Portrait Gallery when she found herself in the White House cross hairs. Now she’s watching another Smithsonian chief go through it.
